channel.title: Ngesa Diaries | Hidden Kenyan Horror Stories & True Mysteries
channel.itunes:author: Dominic Nyongesa
channel.itunes:summary: An open-source investigative audio documentary series exploring Kenya's most terrifying declassified folklore, urban legends, nocturnal phenomena, and supernatural mysteries. From the hereditary night runners of Western Kenya to the haunted waters of Mama Ngina and the starvation woods of Chakama.
channel.description: Ngesa Diaries is a narrative-driven audio documentary uncovering the dark folklore, haunted geography, urban legends, and chilling mysteries of Kenya. Hosted and produced by cybersecurity analyst and researcher Dominic Nyongesa.

item.title: EP 01: The Midnight Knock (The Night Runners of Western Kenya)
item.itunes:author: Dominic Nyongesa
item.itunes:subtitle: Mud slaps on iron roofs, supernatural speed, and the hereditary night runners of Lake Victoria.
item.itunes:summary: In the villages along Lake Victoria and Gucha, midnight brings a chilling silence broken by mud slapping corrugated iron roofs. We investigate the Abanyasi—individuals bound by hereditary compulsion to sprint bare through thorny thickets and terrify neighbors without ever breaking inside.
item.itunes:keywords: night runners, abanyasi, homa bay, kisii, folklore, kenya, supernatural

item.title: EP 02: The Ghost Bus of Ngong Road (KBS 666 & The Red Matatu)
item.itunes:author: Dominic Nyongesa
item.itunes:subtitle: The midnight phantom transit that stops for stranded commuters near the forest cemetery.
item.itunes:summary: For decades, Nairobi commuters have whispered tales of the ghost bus appearing past 1:00 AM in the cold mist between Adams Arcade and the Karen forest junction: unblinking passengers, zero-reading speedometers, and routes dissolving into eucalyptus trees.
item.itunes:keywords: ghost bus, nairobi, ngong road, urban legend, kbs, phantom vehicle

item.title: EP 03: Kirima kia Ngoma: The Whispers of Menengai Crater
item.itunes:author: Dominic Nyongesa
item.itunes:subtitle: The volcanic amphitheater where warrior ghosts, phantom tractors, and unexplained disappearances collide.
item.itunes:summary: Towering above Nakuru town, Menengai Caldera ('The Hill of Devils') holds centuries of dark history—from the 1854 Maasai warrior clashes to phantom tractors plowing lava beds at 3 AM and hikers vanishing into sulfurous mist.
item.itunes:keywords: menengai, nakuru, kirima kia ngoma, haunted crater, maasai history, disappearances

item.title: EP 04: The Goat-Footed Stranger of Mama Ngina (The Mombasa Jinn)
item.itunes:author: Dominic Nyongesa
item.itunes:subtitle: Ancestral spirit pacts, the haunted ruins of Gedi, and the woman who lures late-night walkers by the ocean.
item.itunes:summary: Along the Swahili coast, tales of majini are woven into everyday life. An investigation into the Mama Ngina waterfront apparitions, Gedi ruins baobabs, and the goat-footed beauty who flags down midnight motorists.
item.itunes:keywords: majini, mombasa, swahili coast, mama ngina, gedi ruins, coastal lore

item.title: EP 05: The Dormitory Above the Crypt (Kenyan Boarding School Hauntings)
item.itunes:author: Dominic Nyongesa
item.itunes:subtitle: Cold hands on the top bunk, phantom footsteps in the corridor, and the bell that rings with no power.
item.itunes:summary: An immersive probe into Kenya's collective boarding school terror: colonial-era dormitories built on settler tombs, marching combat boots in locked hallways, and the unpowered brass bell tolling at 3:15 AM.
item.itunes:keywords: boarding school, dormitory, kenyan youth, high school horror, limuru, phantom bell

item.title: EP 06: The Vanishing at Kikopey (The Lady in White of Salgaa)
item.itunes:author: Dominic Nyongesa
item.itunes:subtitle: The fog of the Great Rift Valley, stalled diesel engines, and the passenger who dissolves in the front seat.
item.itunes:summary: Along the treacherous Northern Corridor highway descent from Kikopey to Salgaa, long-distance haulage truckers recount harrowing encounters with the barefoot Lady in White who vanishes mid-transit.
item.itunes:keywords: salgaa, kikopey, lady in white, highway ghost, rift valley, truckers

item.title: EP 07: The Starvation Woods of Chakama (The Shakahola Cult Files)
item.itunes:author: Dominic Nyongesa
item.itunes:subtitle: An 800-acre forest of silence: The harrowing investigative forensics of Kenya's deadliest cult.
item.itunes:summary: A somber, declassified investigative breakdown into how forensic anthropologists and human rights trackers uncovered over 400 shallow graves across the thorny thickets of Chakama Ranch in Kilifi County.
item.itunes:keywords: shakahola, kilifi, chakama, true crime, cult forensics, investigative journalism

item.title: EP 08: The Brain-Eater of Kakamega (The Legend of the Chemosit)
item.itunes:author: Dominic Nyongesa
item.itunes:subtitle: The ferocious mythological man-beast of the Nandi and Kakamega rainforests.
item.itunes:summary: Deep inside Kakamega's tropical rainforest canopy and the Nandi Hills, we explore the terrifying century-old enigma of the Chemosit (Nandi Bear)—a ferocious arboreal predator that haunts indigenous folklore.
item.itunes:keywords: chemosit, nandi bear, kakamega forest, cryptid, kenyan folklore, anthropology
